get_task.description: Fetch a task by ID with everything it produced: the text result, any files, the live viewer link, and the steps the browser agent took. Run this once 'is_finished' is true to read a workflow's results.

steps.evaluation_previous_goal: No previous action taken yet; this is the initial step.
steps.step_goal: Navigate to the search results page for 'laptops'.

steps.evaluation_previous_goal: Navigation succeeded and the results page rendered.
steps.step_goal: Extract the name and price of the first 10 products.

get_task.name: get_task

parameters.description: The ID of the task to look at (the ID shown against the run on the BrowserAct task list, or the 'id' the run-task API returned).
parameters.name: task_id

created_at.description: When the task was created, in ISO 8601 format.

failure_reason.description: Why the task failed, or null if it did not fail.

finished_at.description: When the task finished, in ISO 8601 format.

input_parameters.description: The input parameters the task ran with, as BrowserAct summarizes them (e.g. 'keyword=laptops; limit=10').

is_finished.description: True once the task is finished, failed, or canceled. False while the browser is still working; poll 'Get task status' until it turns true.

live_url.description: Link to watch the browser session live while the task runs.

output_files.description: Links to the files the workflow produced, such as the extracted data as a spreadsheet.

output_text.description: The text result the workflow produced, or null when it produced files only or has not finished.

profile_id.description: ID of the browser profile the task used, when one was saved.

status.description: One of created, running, pausing, paused, finished, canceled, failed, or unknown.

steps.description: What the browser agent did, one entry per step.

evaluation_previous_goal.description: The agent's own verdict on how the previous step went.

screenshot_url.description: Link to the screenshot taken at this step.

status.description: How the step ended, e.g. succeed.

step.description: The step's position in the run, from 1.

step_goal.description: What the agent set out to do in this step.

workflow_id.description: ID of the workflow the task ran.

get_task_status.description: Check whether a task is still running. This is the cheap endpoint to poll while a task works: put it in a loop with a Wait step until 'is_finished' is true, then call 'Get task'.
get_task_status.name: get_task_status

parameters.description: The ID of the task to look at (the ID shown against the run on the BrowserAct task list, or the 'id' the run-task API returned).
parameters.name: task_id

is_finished.description: True once the task is finished, failed, or canceled; false while it is still working.

status.description: One of created, running, pausing, paused, finished, canceled, failed, or unknown.

list_workflows.description: List the workflows on your BrowserAct account, newest first, with each one's ID, description, and when it was published.
list_workflows.name: list_workflows

parameters.description: Which page of results to return. Starts at 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many workflows to return per page, from 1 to 500.
parameters.name: limit

limit.description: How many workflows a page holds.

page.description: The page of results this is.

total_count.description: How many workflows the account has.

total_pages.description: How many pages of workflows there are.

created_at.description: When the workflow was created, in ISO 8601 format.

published_at.description: When the workflow was last published, in ISO 8601 format. Null while it is still a draft.

stop_task.description: Stop a running task for good, useful when a workflow is taking too long or was started by mistake. A stopped task cannot be resumed or restarted.
stop_task.name: stop_task

parameters.description: The ID of the task to look at (the ID shown against the run on the BrowserAct task list, or the 'id' the run-task API returned).
parameters.name: task_id

stopped.description: True once BrowserAct accepted the stop request.

description: Follow the BrowserAct tasks your workflows are running: check whether a task has finished, read the data its browser agent collected, and stop a run that is going nowhere.
